examples.zh: 我们坚定不移地走自己的路。
examples.en: We will unwaveringly follow our own path.

examples.zh: 她坚定不移地支持丈夫的决定。
examples.en: She stood firmly behind her husband's decision.

examples.zh: 只要目标坚定不移，就一定能成功。
examples.en: As long as your goal is steadfast, you will succeed.

usage.en: Usually adverbial (坚定不移地 + verb). Very common in official speeches.
usage.zh: 多作状语（坚定不移地……），官方讲话常用。

meaning.en: At any time and in any place.
meaning.zh: 不论什么时候、什么地方。

examples.zh: 有了手机，随时随地都能上网。
examples.en: With a phone you can go online anytime, anywhere.

examples.zh: 遇到问题随时随地给我打电话。
examples.en: Call me whenever and wherever you run into a problem.

examples.zh: 安全意识要随时随地保持。
examples.en: Safety awareness must be kept up at all times and places.

usage.en: Adverbial; extremely common.
usage.zh: 作状语，极常用。

meaning.en: Rich and colourful; full of variety.

examples.zh: 学校组织了丰富多彩的课外活动。
examples.en: The school organised a rich variety of extracurricular activities.

examples.zh: 退休后他的生活丰富多彩。
examples.en: His life in retirement is full and colourful.

examples.zh: 这里的民族文化丰富多彩。
examples.en: The ethnic cultures here are rich and diverse.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; a school-essay favourite.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，作文常用。

meaning.en: The repercussions of an event have not yet died down.
meaning.zh: 事件虽已过去，但影响还没有消失。

examples.zh: 丑闻余波未平，又有新的问题曝光。
examples.en: The scandal's fallout hadn't died down when new problems emerged.

examples.zh: 上次风波余波未平，大家都很谨慎。
examples.en: With the last row still rumbling on, everyone is being careful.

usage.en: News language. Often 余波未平，一波又起.
usage.zh: 新闻用语，常说“余波未平，一波又起”。

examples.zh: 我们会一如既往地支持你。
examples.en: We'll support you as we always have.

examples.zh: 他一如既往地早到半小时。
examples.en: As usual, he arrived half an hour early.

examples.zh: 这家店的服务一如既往地好。
examples.en: The service here is as good as ever.

usage.en: Usually adverbial: 一如既往地 + verb. Common in thanks and pledges.
usage.zh: 多作状语，常用于致谢、表态。

examples.zh: 众所周知，吸烟有害健康。
examples.en: As everyone knows, smoking harms your health.

examples.zh: 这是一个众所周知的事实。
examples.en: This is a well-known fact.

examples.zh: 他们的关系不好，这已经众所周知了。
examples.en: It's common knowledge that they don't get on.

usage.en: Often sentence-initial: 众所周知，…
usage.zh: 常放句首：众所周知，……

examples.zh: 一年一度的春节又到了。
examples.en: The annual Spring Festival is here again.

examples.zh: 公司一年一度的年会在下周举行。
examples.en: The company's yearly party is next week.

usage.en: Attributive: 一年一度的 + event.
usage.zh: 多作定语：一年一度的……

examples.zh: 父母千方百计给孩子治病。
examples.en: The parents tried every possible way to cure their child.

examples.zh: 骗子千方百计地骗取老人的钱。
examples.en: Swindlers use every trick to cheat old people of their money.

examples.zh: 我们要千方百计增加农民收入。
examples.en: We must do everything possible to raise farmers' incomes.

usage.en: Adverbial; can be praise or criticism depending on the goal.
usage.zh: 作状语，褒贬视目的而定。

meaning.en: Emerging one after another without end.
meaning.zh: 接连不断地出现，没有穷尽。

examples.zh: 网络诈骗手段层出不穷。
examples.en: New online scams keep popping up.

examples.zh: 这几年新技术层出不穷。
examples.en: New technologies have emerged one after another in recent years.

examples.zh: 人才层出不穷，后浪推前浪。
examples.en: Talent keeps emerging, each wave pushing the last.

usage.en: Predicate; neutral (new ideas) or negative (problems).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，可褒可贬。

examples.zh: 她的红裙子在人群中特别引人注目。
examples.en: Her red dress was especially eye-catching in the crowd.

examples.zh: 这项研究取得了引人注目的成果。
examples.en: The research achieved striking results.

examples.zh: 他不喜欢引人注目，总坐在角落。
examples.en: He doesn't like attention and always sits in the corner.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Also 引人瞩目 in formal writing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；书面也说“引人瞩目”。

meaning.en: The most urgent matter at present.

examples.zh: 当务之急是把伤员送到医院。
examples.en: The top priority is getting the wounded to hospital.

examples.zh: 解决就业问题是当务之急。
examples.en: Tackling unemployment is the most pressing task.

story.en: Mencius: 'The wise know everything, but treat what is currently pressing as most urgent' (知者无不知也，当务之为急).
story.zh: 《孟子》：“知者无不知也，当务之为急。”

usage.en: Usually subject or predicate: 当务之急是…
usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语：当务之急是……

meaning.zh: 超越或不正当地使用职务上的权力。

examples.zh: 这名官员因滥用职权被起诉。
examples.en: The official was prosecuted for abuse of power.

examples.zh: 任何人都不能滥用职权谋取私利。
examples.en: No one may abuse their position for personal gain.

usage.en: Legal and news term (滥用职权罪).
usage.zh: 法律、新闻用语，如“滥用职权罪”。

meaning.en: Deeply accepted and embraced by people.
meaning.zh: 深深地进入人们心中，被广泛接受。

examples.zh: 环保理念已经深入人心。
examples.en: The idea of protecting the environment has taken root.

examples.zh: 这个角色塑造得深入人心。
examples.en: The character was portrayed so well it stuck in people's minds.

examples.zh: 这首歌旋律优美，深入人心。
examples.en: The song's beautiful melody has won people's hearts.

usage.en: Predicate; for ideas, policies, images.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于观念、政策、形象。

meaning.en: To break free of outdated ideas and dogma.
meaning.zh: 打破旧观念、旧习惯的束缚。

examples.zh: 改革开放首先要解放思想。
examples.en: Reform and opening up require, first of all, freeing our thinking.

examples.zh: 企业要发展，必须解放思想，大胆创新。
examples.en: For a company to grow it must break with old thinking and innovate boldly.

origin.source: 邓小平《解放思想，实事求是，团结一致向前看》（1978）

story.en: Deng Xiaoping's December 1978 speech, 'Emancipate the Mind, Seek Truth from Facts, and Unite as One in Looking to the Future', launched the reform era and made the phrase a national slogan.
story.zh: 1978年12月邓小平发表讲话《解放思想，实事求是，团结一致向前看》，开启改革开放，此语成为时代口号。

usage.en: A key political slogan of the reform era, usually with 实事求是.
usage.zh: 改革开放时期的重要口号，常与“实事求是”连用。

meaning.en: To extort money or property by threats or deception.
meaning.zh: 用威胁、欺骗手段强行索取财物。

examples.zh: 这伙人因敲诈勒索被抓。
examples.en: The gang was arrested for extortion.

examples.zh: 他拿照片敲诈勒索前女友。
examples.en: He blackmailed his ex-girlfriend with the photos.

usage.en: Legal and news term (敲诈勒索罪).
usage.zh: 法律、新闻用语。

meaning.zh: 名声与实际相符，确实不错。

examples.zh: 桂林山水果然名不虚传。
examples.en: Guilin's scenery really lives up to its reputation.

examples.zh: 这家店的烤鸭名不虚传。
examples.en: This restaurant's roast duck is as good as they say.

examples.zh: 他的球技名不虚传。
examples.en: His skill on the ball deserves its fame.

usage.en: Often with 果然/真是 after seeing for oneself.
usage.zh: 常与“果然”“真是”连用。

examples.zh: 事故造成三人死亡、两人下落不明。
examples.en: The accident left three dead and two missing.

examples.zh: 那幅名画至今下落不明。
examples.en: The famous painting's whereabouts are still unknown.

usage.en: News register; for people and objects.
usage.zh: 新闻用语，指人或物。

examples.zh: 救灾物资源源不断地运往灾区。
examples.en: Relief supplies are flowing steadily into the disaster area.

examples.zh: 新鲜的想法源源不断。
examples.en: Fresh ideas keep coming.

examples.zh: 工厂为市场源源不断地提供产品。
examples.en: The factory supplies the market with a steady stream of products.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语。

examples.zh: 统计数据不能弄虚作假。
examples.en: Statistics must not be falsified.

examples.zh: 考试中弄虚作假将被取消成绩。
examples.en: Cheating in the exam will cancel your results.

examples.zh: 这家公司因弄虚作假被罚款。
examples.en: The company was fined for fraud.

usage.en: Official criticism of falsified data or results.
usage.zh: 多用于批评数据、成绩造假。

examples.zh: 要坚决纠正行业不正之风。
examples.en: Malpractice in the industry must be firmly corrected.

examples.zh: 送礼请客的不正之风必须刹住。
examples.en: The bad practice of gifts and banquets must be stopped.

usage.en: Official term for corruption, nepotism and similar.
usage.zh: 官方用语，指腐败、拉关系等。

examples.zh: 经济发展是国家长治久安的基础。
examples.en: Economic development is the basis of lasting national stability.

examples.zh: 要从根本上解决问题，才能长治久安。
examples.en: Only by tackling the root cause can there be long-term stability.

story.en: Jia Yi urged Emperor Wen to 'build the foundation of long peace and accomplish the work of lasting order' (建久安之势，成长治之业).
story.zh: 贾谊上疏汉文帝：“建久安之势，成长治之业。”

usage.en: Official, political register.
usage.zh: 官方、政治用语。

examples.zh: 他是个不折不扣的球迷。
examples.en: He's a football fan through and through.

examples.zh: 这些规定必须不折不扣地执行。
examples.en: These rules must be carried out to the letter.

examples.zh: 这完全是一场不折不扣的骗局。
examples.en: This is an out-and-out scam.

usage.en: Attributive (不折不扣的骗子) or adverbial.
usage.zh: 可作定语或状语。

meaning.en: Worries left behind that distract one from the task ahead.
meaning.zh: 来自后方或家里的忧虑。

examples.zh: 政府为外出务工人员解决子女上学问题，消除了他们的后顾之忧。
examples.en: The government sorted out schooling for migrant workers' children, removing a big worry.

examples.zh: 有了父母照顾孩子，她工作没有后顾之忧。
examples.en: With her parents looking after the kids, she can work worry-free.

usage.en: Usually 没有/解除/消除后顾之忧.
usage.zh: 常说“没有（解除、消除）后顾之忧”。

meaning.en: A life of extravagant luxury and decadence.
meaning.zh: 形容奢侈豪华、腐化的生活。

equivalents: a life of luxury and excess

examples.zh: 他沉迷于纸醉金迷的生活，很快就破产了。
examples.en: Lost in a life of luxury and excess, he was soon bankrupt.

examples.zh: 这座城市的夜晚纸醉金迷。
examples.en: The city's nights are a whirl of decadence.

examples.zh: 小说描写了上海滩金迷纸醉的生活。
examples.en: The novel portrays the decadent high life of old Shanghai.

story.en: The physician Meng Fu decorated a small room entirely with gold leaf paper. Visitors said: 'Resting a moment in this room, one is dazzled by gold and drunk on paper' (令人金迷纸醉).
story.zh: 唐末医生孟斧有一小室，器物都用金箔纸包裹，人说：“此室暂憩，令人金迷纸醉。”

usage.en: Critical. Also 金迷纸醉.
usage.zh: 含贬义。也作“金迷纸醉”。

meaning.zh: 自己的能力所能做到的。

examples.zh: 孩子应该做些力所能及的家务。
examples.en: Children should do the housework they can manage.

examples.zh: 我会在力所能及的范围内帮助你。
examples.en: I'll help you as far as I can.

examples.zh: 老人做点力所能及的事，身体更好。
examples.en: Doing what they can keeps old people healthier.

usage.en: Usually attributive: 力所能及的事 / 范围.
usage.zh: 多作定语：力所能及的事（范围）。
